- Initial release of thumbtack-mcp skill.
- Query Thumbtack.com from the shell to search local pros and read their profiles.
- Supports plain curl requests to Thumbtack's search, profile, and GraphQL endpoints without API key or login.
- Provides a Node.js extractor script to parse and output JSON data from various page types.
- Includes usage rules, caveats, and ready-to-run data extraction examples with jq.
- Fully anonymous, read-only access—does not handle booked projects, logins, or partner APIs.
